test_vectors.coverage: Exact OpenAPI 3.1.0 and AsyncAPI 3.0.0 JSON bytes, media types, omitted servers, and one final newline.

Ordered POST paths, shared tool identities, descriptions, service tags, required JSON requests, closed field schemas, response 200, streaming extensions, u32::MAX codes, exact i64 limits, and absent stream omission.
Streaming-only channel and operation order, RPC addresses, result payloads, send actions, and JSON Pointer resolution to channels and result messages.
Public, All, exact role intersection, case sensitivity, empty role grants, hidden metadata exclusion, and unary-only AsyncAPI catalogs.
Exact output limit succeeds, one byte less fails, zero and small limits fail, UTF-8 byte accounting, escaping expansion, server data, and recursive reference overhead.

Self and mutual recursion, struct tables, reachable local definitions, escaped OpenAPI path and content-type pointer components, distinct request/response/stream locations, and AsyncAPI payload locations.
Visible schemas resolve named definitions declared in hidden endpoints, while unrelated definitions and hidden endpoint metadata remain absent.

Every EndpointType variant, NanoId lengths 1 and 255, optional arrays, registered inline definitions, enum signed extrema, prefixed enum names, and schema equivalence with Wave 2 after reference relocation.
Hidden unresolved references, invalid NanoId length, duplicate codes and fields, and endpoint service mismatches return canonical errors.

Wrong registry kinds, invalid identifiers, duplicate definitions and fields, duplicate enum values, missing and wrong-kind references, accepted exact registered copies, and rejected conflicting or repeated inline definitions.
Zero depth rejection, depth-one primitives, hidden depth violations, exact nested depth success, u16::MAX options, and nonwrapping child-depth arithmetic.
256 owned array wrappers, exact structural depth limits, explicit traversal, and named recursion within a depth-two registry.

HTTP and HTTPS, case-insensitive schemes, ports 0 and 65535, IPv4, bracketed IPv6, IPv4-mapped IPv6, userinfo, percent escapes, base path retention, and host extraction independent of query and fragment.

Relative and empty URLs, unsupported schemes, missing hosts, malformed ports, controls, spaces, backslashes, malformed percent escapes, malformed IP literals, duplicate authority separators, and repeated fragment delimiters.
All ASCII control characters, quote and backslash escapes, Unicode and emoji metadata, arbitrary field keys, and JSON Pointer token escaping.
Exact signed integer text, u32::MAX, atomic rejected appends, UTF-8 byte boundaries, empty appends at capacity, and allocation failure error classification.
Repeated byte stability, multiple services, endpoint and field order, role order, outer optionality, nested nullable array items, and input immutability.
